sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MODELS ARE FAIRLY SIMILAR CONCERNING THE EVOLUTION OF THE AMPLIFIED TROUGH WITHIN THE SOUTHERN BRANCH OF SPLIT POLAR WESTERLIES NOW MIGRATING ACROSS CALIFORNIA INTO THE GREAT BASIN AND SOUTHERN PLATEAU. AS AN UPSTREAM NORTHERN BRANCH IMPULSE APPROACHES THE BRITISH COLUMBIA/PACIFIC NORTHWEST COAST...THE LARGER SCALE TROUGH IS PROGGED TO GRADUALLY DEVELOP EASTWARD ACROSS THE ROCKIES LATER TODAY/TONIGHT. THIS IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR...AS AN EMBEDDED CLOSED LOW LIFTS OUT OF THE LOWER COLORADO VALLEY THROUGH THE CENTRAL ROCKIES AND WEAKENS...WHILE ANOTHER SHORT WAVE IMPULSE AND ASSOCIATED JET STREAK DIG THROUGH THE NORTHWEST MEXICAN PLATEAU...BEFORE TURNING EASTWARD ACROSS THE SOUTHERN ROCKIES/HIGH PLAINS. A SECONDARY MID-LEVEL CIRCULATION MAY BEGIN TO FORM OVER THE TEXAS SOUTH PLAINS BY EARLY SUNDAY. MEANWHILE...THE DOWNSTREAM FLOW REGIME ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE U.S. INTO THE WESTERN ATLANTIC WILL BEGIN TO SHARPEN...WITH A RIDGE BUILDING THROUGH THE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...AND A TROUGH DIGGING SOUTHEAST OF THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION INTO AREAS OFF THE NORTHERN/MID ATLANTIC COAST. THE WEAKENING REMNANTS OF THE COMPACT BUT VIGOROUS CLOSED LOW...WHICH HAS CONTRIBUTED TO A WIDESPREAD SEVER

sections.title: SOUTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: IN THE WAKE OF AN EXPANSIVE COLD SURFACE RIDGE...RETREATING TO THE EAST OF THE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...MODELS INDICATE A WEAK LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE RETURN TO THE VICINITY OF A DEVELOPING LEE SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS PARTS OF WEST TEXAS INTO EASTERN NEW MEXICO TODAY. THIS IS WHERE STRONGEST SURFACE HEATING IS EXPECTED...WHICH...COUPLED WITH AT LEAST MODESTLY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...MAY CONTRIBUTE TO WEAK MIXED LAYER CAPE ON THE ORDER OF 500-750 J/KG. ASSOCIATED WITH THE INITIAL CLOSED LOW LIFTING INTO THE CENTRAL ROCKIES...A 50-70 KT SOUTH SOUTHWESTERLY...CYCLONIC 500 MB JET STREAK IS PROGGED TO NOSE ACROSS EASTERN NEW MEXICO DURING AND SHORTLY AFTER THE PEAK HEATING HOURS. THIS IS EXPECTED TO BE ACCOMPANIED BY WEAKENING INHIBITION ABOVE THE HEATED BOUNDARY LAYER...WHICH SHOULD ALLOW FOR THE INITIATION OF CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT BY LATE AFTERNOON. THIS MAY INCLUDE A FEW SUPERCELLS WITH THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. WHILE LOW-LEVEL TEMPERATURE/DEW POINT SPREADS WITHIN THE FAIRLY DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER MAY BE SOMEWHAT LARGE...SIZABLE CLOCKWISE CURVED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS COULD SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST BRIEF TORNADOES. INTO THE EVENING HOURS...STRENGTHENING LOW LE

sections.title: FLORIDA
sections.text: THE LARGE-SCALE PATTERN EVOLUTION IS PROGGED TO RESULT IN STRENGTHENING NORTHWESTERLY MID/UPPER FLOW ACROSS THE FLORIDA PENINSULA TODAY...CONTRIBUTING TO DEEP LAYER SHEAR FAVORABLE FOR SIGNIFICANT MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION. THIS SHOULD BE MOST PRONOUNCED ALONG THE CENTRAL ATLANTIC COAST SEA BREEZE...WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MAXIMIZED. ALTHOUGH WARM TEMPERATURES/SUBSIDENCE ALOFT...ASSOCIATED WITH A BUILDING HIGH LEVEL RIDGE...WILL BE POTENTIAL LIMITING FACTORS TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...AN ISOLATED STRONG OR SEVERE STORM APPEARS POSSIBLE DURING THE AFTERNOON HOURS. ..KERR/GRAMS.. 04/11/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE SRN PLNS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... AMPLIFIED BUT PROGRESSIVE PATTERN WILL CONTINUE THIS PERIOD AS WRN AZ UPR LOW MOVES SLOWLY E TO THE FOUR CORNERS REGION THIS EVE...AND CONTINUES E INTO NE NM EARLY SUNDAY. AT THE SFC...LEE TROUGH NOW DEVELOPING IN THE HI PLNS SHOULD CONSOLIDATE INTO LEE LOW OVER NRN CHIHUAHUA LATER TODAY. THE LOW SHOULD REDEVELOP GENERALLY E ACROSS S TX OVERNIGHT...REACHING THE AREA BETWEEN SAT AND HOU BY 12Z SUN. FARTHER E...TRAILING COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH UPR SYSTEM THAT CROSSED THE SERN STATES YESTERDAY WILL SETTLE SLOWLY S ACROSS NRN/CNTRL FL.

sections.title: ERN NM INTO WRN/CNTRL TX
sections.text: A SHALLOW LAYER OF COOL POST-FRONTAL AIR HAS SETTLED SW ACROSS MOST OF TX THIS MORNING. LOW LVL MOISTURE WILL...HOWEVER...SPREAD NW UP THE RIO GRANDE VLY AND N ACROSS SRN/CNTRL TX CSTL PLN LATER TODAY/TONIGHT AS LLJ INTENSIFIES AHEAD OF AZ TROUGH. FARTHER W...MODERATELY MOIST POST-FRONTAL AIR WILL MOVE NNW ACROSS PARTS OF W TX AND ERN NM ALONG STRENGTHENING LEE TROUGH. ALOFT...A RESIDUAL EML WILL EXIST FROM S CNTRL TX NW INTO NM. GIVEN THE LIMITED LOW LVL MOISTURE AND EML CAP...TSTMS SHOULD REMAIN SPARSE E OF THE NM MOUNTAINS UNTIL LATER IN THE DAY WHEN HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITH APPROACHING TROUGH...WEAK UPSLOPE COMPONENTS...AND HEATING DESTABILIZE REGION ALONG LEE TROUGH/DRY LINE. THIS MAY RESULT IN SCTD STORMS/POSSIBLE SUPERCELLS IN SW TX/FAR SE NM AS DEEP SSWLY SHEAR INCREASES TO AOA 50 KTS. WITH SBCAPE UP TO 1000 J/KG...SETUP COULD YIELD A FEW STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL/LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO THROUGH EARLY EVE. LATER TONIGHT AND EARLY SUN...EXPECT MORE WIDESPREAD STORMS TO DEVELOP ATOP SHALLOW COOL AIR DOME ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WRN/NW AND...EVENTUALLY...CNTRL TX AS UPR TROUGH CONTINUES EWD TO ENCOUNTER INCREASINGLY RICH MOISTURE RETURN IN THE 92

sections.title: FL
sections.text: A BAND OF MODERATE /50+ KT/ WNW FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER FL TODAY ...ALONG SW FRINGE OF UPR SYSTEM DEPARTING THE MID ATLANTIC CST. AS A RESULT...AMPLE DEEP NWLY SHEAR WILL EXIST FOR SUSTAINED STORMS...AND POSSIBLY A BRIEFLY ROTATING STORM OR TWO...IN AREA S OF WEAKENING COLD FRONT. DEEP UPLIFT OVER THE STATE WILL...HOWEVER...BE QUITE LIMITED. AT THE SAME TIME...LOW LVL ASCENT WILL BE FOCUSED ALONG THE E CST SEA BREEZE FRONT. OVERALL SETUP SUGGESTS THE POSSIBILITY FOR A COUPLE STRONG DIURNAL STORMS IN THAT REGION...DESPITE WARMING TEMPERATURES/SUBSIDENCE ALOFT ASSOCIATED WITH APPROACHING SHORTWAVE RIDGE. ..CORFIDI/JEWELL.. 04/11/2009

sections.text: COOL/STABLE AIR CURRENTLY IN PLACE OVER THE SRN PLAINS...ALTHOUGH NOSE OF HIGHER H85 DEW POINTS EVIDENT THIS MORNING OVER SRN TX INTO THE BIG BEND REGION WILL CONTINUE N-NWWD THROUGH THE DAY. THIS WILL OCCUR AHEAD OF STRONG UPPER LOW NOW MOVING ACROSS THE SWRN STATES. SURFACE DEW POINTS HAVE YET TO RECOVER AWAY FROM DEEP SOUTH TX... ALTHOUGH ADVECTION AND DOWNWARD MIXING WITHIN THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT AXIS OF NEAR TO LOWER 50S F SURFACE DEW POINTS INTO SWRN TX AND PERHAPS FAR SERN NM BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON. AS THIS OCCURS...CAP WILL GRADUALLY WEAKEN AND SUPPORT INCREASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT LATE TODAY AND THIS EVENING OVER ERN NM INTO WRN/SWRN TX. MODELS SUGGEST THIS COULD OCCUR AS EARLY AS 21Z. DEEP LAYER SHEAR REMAINS MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR SUPERCELLS... ALTHOUGH EVOLUTION INTO A MORE LINEAR CONFIGURATION IS EXPECTED THROUGH THE EVENING. ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE AND A TORNADO OR TWO REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH SURFACE BASED STORMS...HOWEVER ACTIVITY WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY ELEVATED WITH EWD EXTENT AND AS THE EVENING PROGRESSES. sections.title: ERN NM/SWRN TX EWD INTO SWRN OK AND N-CNTRL TX
sections.text: ONLY SMALL CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO SEVERE PROBABILITIES. GOES SOUNDER...GPS PW AND SURFACE OBSERVATIONAL DATA ALL INDICATE THAT RAPID MOISTENING OF AIR MASS IS OCCURRING THROUGH THE LOWER RIO GRANDE VALLEY INTO WRN TX ALONG 30 KT SELY LLJ. THIS MOISTURE RETURN IS OCCURRING BENEATH EML WHICH IS SUPPORTING AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION E OF LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM THE ERN NM PLAINS INTO SWRN TX. DIURNAL TSTMS ARE STILL EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN STRENGTH AND COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING FROM ERN NM INTO SWRN/WRN TX WITHIN KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTIVE OF SUSTAINED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS AS BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE WILL REMAIN SOMEWHAT MARGINAL THROUGH THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE. THE THREAT FOR A TORNADO OR TWO MAY INCREASE BY EVENING WITH ANY SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS THAT REMAIN SURFACE-BASED WITHIN MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER. OVERNIGHT...ELEVATED TSTMS SHOULD BECOME FAIRLY WIDESPREAD FROM THE CONCHO VALLEY AND EDWARDS PLATEAU REGION NWD THROUGH THE RED RIVER VALLEY WITHIN ZONE OF DEEP LAYER ASCENT AHEAD OF UPPER LOW. THE COMBINATION OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG AND 40-55 KT OF EFFECT

sections.title: TX HILL COUNTRY
sections.text: HIGHER HAIL PROBABILITIES AND CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK HAVE BEEN EXTENDED SEWD INTO REGION. LATEST MESOSCALE AND HIGHER-RESOLUTION DATA SETS INDICATE THAT A POTENTIALLY SEPARATE AREA OF TSTMS MAY DEVELOP OVERNIGHT TO THE N OF RETREATING MARINE/WARM FRONT WITHIN ZONE OF ENHANCED MOISTENING AND WAA ALONG LLJ AXIS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT ANY DEVELOPING STORMS SHOULD REMAIN SLIGHTLY ELEVATED WITHIN A STRONGLY SHEARED KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT WITH HAIL BEING THE MAIN THREAT. ..MEAD.. 04/11/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SAT APR 11 2009/

sections.text: HIGH-AMPLITUDE UPPER TROUGH/LOW -- CENTERED INVOF THE FOUR CORNERS ATTM -- WILL PROGRESS STEADILY EWD ACROSS THE SRN ROCKIES AND INTO THE SRN PLAINS THE REMAINDER OF THE PERIOD. sections.title: PARTS OF WRN AND NRN TX INTO SWRN OK
sections.text: WIDESPREAD THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ATTM ACROSS THE TX SOUTH PLAINS REGION AND VICINITY...WITH MORE ISOLATED STORMS ACROSS A LARGER/SURROUNDING AREA. SUPERCELLS ONGOING IN A NARROW N-S ZONE OF SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY -- NEAR AND NE OF MIDLAND TX -- HAVE PRODUCED LARGE HAIL...TAKING ADVANTAGE OF MIXED-LAYER CAPE APPROACHING 1000 J/KG AND 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 70 KT PER THE LATEST JAYTON TX PROFILER. THIS CONVECTION WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY-ELEVATED WITH TIME THIS EVENING...AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS AND STORMS SHIFT ENEWD ATOP A COOLER/MORE STABLE AIRMASS IN PLACE ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE SRN PLAINS. INCREASING WARM ADVECTION AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING UPPER FEATURE ATOP THE STABLE LOWER-LEVEL AIRMASS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT INCREASINGLY-WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES -- PER EVENING RAOBS -- ABOVE THIS LOW-LEVEL WARMING/MOISTENING...AMPLE ELEVATED INSTABILITY EXISTS TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR HAIL -- AND THUS CONTINUATION OF THE SLIGHT RISK FORECAST. THE MAIN AREA OF CONVECTION WILL SPREAD EWD WITH TIME...WITH STORMS -- AND SOME HAIL POTENTIAL -- EXTENDING AS FAR E AS THE TX COAST/E TX/ERN OK BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. ..GOSS.. 04/12/2009
